bettereasyplace.config.comment.allowEati: If enabled, holding food and eating will not be blocked by Easy Place mode.
bettereasyplace.config.comment.allowFire: If enabled, using fireworks while flying with elytra will not be blocked by Easy Place mode.
bettereasyplace.config.comment.enableBlo: If enabled, blocks in the blacklist will not be blocked by Easy Place mode.
bettereasyplace.config.comment.blockBlac: Blocks listed here will not be blocked by Easy Place mode (one block ID per line, e.g. minecraft:chest).
bettereasyplace.config.comment.allowShul: If enabled, you can open placed shulker boxes while holding blocks, and place shulker boxes without Easy Place interception.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.bettereas: A mod that improves the easy place functionality of Litematica
